verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes sandbox security features (non-root user scoping, outbound proxy/domain allowlists, secrets management, scoped session tokens) but never documents the underlying isolation mechanism (e.g., microVM, Firecracker, gVisor, or hypervisor-level separation) between sandboxes and host/other tenants. Without a stated hard isolation boundary technology, a platform engineer cannot verify the claim. Missing for 10: explicit architecture documentation naming a microVM or equivalent isolation technology, any independent/hands-on verification of isolation strength.
